title_sq: TRUALL ME LEJE NDERTIMI PER SHITJE NE SURREL.
description_sq:
Ne zonen e Surrelit ofrojme per shitje 2560 m2 truall.
Trualli ka pozicionim strategjik i cili ofron pamje panoramike nga liqeni i surrelit.
Punimet extra si rrethimi, rilevimi i truallit kanalizimet gjithashtu dhe leja e ndertimit e miratuar per nje vile unike e bejne nje mundesi mjaft te mire per banim ne nje zone ku behen bashke relaxi, qetesia, ajri i paster dhe pamja panoramike nga liqeni.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor gjithashtu dhe lejen e ndertimit te miratuar bashke me projektin gati per zbatim ne terren.
Me kontaktoni per info te metejshme.
title_en: PLOT WITH BUILDING PERMIT FOR SALE IN SURREL.
description_en: In the area of ​​Surrel, we offer for sale 2560 m2 of land. The plot has a strategic positioning that offers a panoramic view of the Surreli lake. Extra works such as fencing, surveying the land, sewers as well as the approved building permit for a unique villa make it a very good opportunity to live in an area where relaxation, tranquility, clean air and a panoramic view from the lake are combined. The property also has regular mortgage documentation and an approved construction permit together with the project ready for implementation on the ground. Contact me for further information.
